content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-263. - Availability of copies.
content.summary:
Copies of the Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications are on file with the
               city clerk and open to public inspection during regular business hours of the city,
               and online at
https://arvada.org/city-hall/city-code/engineering-code-of-standards-and-specifications
…

faqs.a:
Copies of the Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications are on file with the
               city clerk and open to public inspection during regular business hours of the city,
               and online at
https://arvada.org/city-hall/city-code/engineering-code-of-standards-and-specifications
.
(Code 1981, § 27-192; Ord. No. 2391, § 1, 1-19-1987; Ord. No. 2429, § 1, 7-20-1987;
Ord. No. 4809
, § 1, 7-18-2022)
